english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for food or drink that provides nutrients and is healthy to consume.
Use this for food that is nourishing and promotes good health, rather than merely being plentiful.
Use this for the nourishing, nutritionally substantial interpretation rather than merely food that is filling.
